permissions.name: thumbs:view
permissions.description: See which files have thumbnails, and why any of them failed

permissions.name: thumbs:generate
permissions.description: Generate or regenerate thumbnails, and delete generated ones

permissions.name: thumbs:settings
permissions.description: Change which formats, sizes and destination thumbnails are generated with

settings.name: auto_generate
settings.description: Generate thumbnails automatically when a file is uploaded or its contents replaced

settings.name: formats
settings.description: File extensions that get thumbnails generated for them

settings.name: sizes
settings.description: The thumbnail sizes to generate for every eligible file

settings.name: destination
settings.description: Where thumbnails are written, relative to the folder the source file is in. Blank writes them alongside the original

settings.name: output_format
settings.description: The image format thumbnails are encoded as: webp, jpg or png

settings.name: quality
settings.description: Encoder quality, 1-100. Ignored for png, which is always lossless

settings.name: video_frame_seconds
settings.description: How far into a video the captured frame is taken from, in seconds

settings.name: concurrency
settings.description: How many files may be processed at once. Each one runs an ffmpeg process per size

settings.name: ffmpeg_path
settings.description: Path to the ffmpeg binary. Blank auto-detects: FFMPEG_PATH, then the ffmpeg-static dependency, then ffmpeg on PATH

settings.name: ffprobe_path
settings.description: Path to the ffprobe binary. Blank auto-detects: FFPROBE_PATH, then the @ffprobe-installer/ffprobe dependency, then ffprobe on PATH

groups.name: kempo-thumbs:operator
groups.description: Can see thumbnail status and regenerate thumbnails, but not change the settings they are generated with
